boxing.definitionKo: 두 사람이 양손에 두꺼운 장갑을 끼고 주먹으로 상대를 쳐서 승부를 겨루는 운동 경기.
boxing.englishDescription: A sports game in which two players wearing thick gloves on both hands compete by hitting each other with their fists.

cabinet.definitionKo: 사무용품이나 서류 등을 넣어 보관하는 장.
cabinet.englishDescription: A piece of furniture that is used to store office supplies, documents, etc.

concoct.definitionKo: 자기의 주장이나 조건에 맞추기 위해 억지로 이유를 대다.
concoct.englishDescription: To make up an excuse to make one's argument or condition look plausible.

mummy.definitionKo: 썩지 않고 건조되어 원래 상태에 가까운 모습으로 남아 있는 인간이나 동물의 사체.
mummy.englishDescription: The corpse of a human or animal, which has dried without being decomposed, and thus remains in a shape close to its original state.

pornography.definitionKo: 인간의 성적 행위를 주로 표현한 책, 영화, 그림 등을 통틀어 이르는 말.
pornography.englishDescription: A term collectively referring to books, photographs, videos, etc., that express mostly sexual activities of people.

shot.definitionKo: 골프에서, 공을 한 번 치는 일.
shot.englishDescription: In golf, the act of hitting a ball once.

steps.definitionKo: 있는 힘을 다하여 매우 다급하게 도망침을 이르는 말.
steps.englishExpression: Legs, please save my life; Steps, please save my life
steps.englishDescription: An exclamation that one says to oneself when running away from danger as fast as one can.

unknowingly.englishExpression: without even oneself knowing; unknowingly; ignorantly
